svg.text: THE RUSSELL PERIODIC CHART OF THE ELEMENTS, NO. 2
LESSON 47 • NINE OCTAVES OF MATTER CENTERED BY STILL MAGNETIC INERT GASES (0)
PERIODICITY IS A CHARACTERISTIC OF ALL PHENOMENA OF NATURE (WALTER RUSSELL, 1926)
-4 • 0 • +4 AMPLITUDE CREST (C • Si • Ti • Zr • Hf • Th)
Nine octaves of elements arise gyroscopically from Inert Gas master-tones (0) through 4+ to Carbon amplitude (90°) and unwind through 4- back to 0.
